nodes.name: Daily Schedule
nodes.notes: Lunes a viernes 09:00. Idempotente por día: no corre dos veces el mismo día.

nodes.name: Manual Trigger (webhook)
nodes.notes: Para demos: POST /webhook/revival-run. Cada llamada manual es una corrida distinta.

nodes.name: Prepare Run
nodes.notes: Config del revival (edítala en build/workflows/revival-config.js): inactividad, tope por corrida, toques, espaciado, modos.

parameters.query:
WITH k AS (SELECT CASE WHEN $1 = 'schedule' THEN 'revival-run:' || to_char(date_trunc('day', now()), 'YYYY-MM-DD') ELSE 'revival-run:manual:' || $2 END AS key),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO idempotency_keys (key, workflow, execution_id, status)
  SELECT key, 'revival-run', $2, 'processing' FROM k
  ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE
    SET execution_id = EXCLUDED.execution_id, status = 'processing', claimed_at = now(), finished_at = NULL,
        attempts = idempotency_keys.attempts + 1
    WHERE idempotency_keys.status = 'failed'
       OR (idempotency_keys.status = 'processing' AND idempotency_keys.claimed_at < now() - interval '1 hour')
  RETURNING key
)
SELECT (SELECT key FROM k) AS key, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins) AS is_new

nodes.name: Claim Idempotency
nodes.notes: Reclamo atómico (PRIMARY KEY). Se puede reprocesar si el intento anterior quedó "failed" o "processing" hace más de 1 h.

nodes.name: Skip (already ran)
nodes.notes: La corrida de hoy ya se hizo (o está en curso).

parameters.query:
SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(key), '[]'::jsonb) FROM suppression_list) AS keys,
       (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(k), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (
          SELECT lower(c.email) AS k FROM revival_state s JOIN revival_contacts c ON c.contact_id = s.contact_id WHERE c.email IS NOT NULL
          UNION
          SELECT norm_phone(c.phone, '57') FROM revival_state s JOIN revival_contacts c ON c.contact_id = s.contact_id WHERE norm_phone(c.phone, '57') IS NOT NULL
       ) e) AS engaged

nodes.name: Load Suppression
nodes.notes: keys = lista de bajas completa (se vuelve a consultar en Send Touch justo antes de cada envío). engaged = email/teléfono de quienes YA tienen secuencia: un duplicado suyo no recibe primer toque.

parameters.query:
WITH new_c AS (
  SELECT c.contact_id, c.name, c.email, c.phone, c.company, c.last_activity_at, c.history, 'new' AS kind, 1 AS touch
  FROM revival_contacts c LEFT JOIN revival_state s ON s.contact_id = c.contact_id
  WHERE s.contact_id IS NULL AND c.last_activity_at < now() - make_interval(days => $1::int)
  ORDER BY c.last_activity_at DESC LIMIT ($2::int * 4)
), due AS (
  SELECT c.contact_id, c.name, c.email, c.phone, c.company, c.last_activity_at, c.history, 'follow_up' AS kind, s.step + 1 AS touch
  FROM revival_state s JOIN revival_contacts c ON c.contact_id = s.contact_id
  WHERE s.status = 'active' AND s.next_touch_at <= now() AND s.step < $3::int
)
SELECT * FROM due UNION ALL SELECT * FROM new_c

nodes.name: Load Candidates
nodes.notes: Contactos inactivos sin secuencia + toques de seguimiento ya vencidos. En modo live este paso sería la búsqueda de contactos en la API de GHL (contrato sin verificar).

nodes.name: Select Candidates
nodes.notes: DETERMINÍSTICO: filtra inválidos y bajas, deduplica por email/teléfono, pone los follow-ups primero y aplica el tope.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO revival_batches (batch_id, status, size, execution_id) VALUES ($1, 'pending_approval', $2::int, $3) RETURNING batch_id

nodes.name: Create Batch
nodes.notes: El lote queda "pending_approval". Send Touch NO envía nada si su lote no está "approved".

nodes.name: Request Batch Approval
nodes.notes: Aprobación humana ANTES de cualquier envío. Canal: email (Mailpit local). Para Slack, cambiar este nodo por Slack → Send and Wait.

nodes.name: Apply Decision
nodes.notes: Falla cerrado: timeout o respuesta ambigua = lote NO aprobado.

parameters.query: UPDATE revival_batches SET status = $2, decided_at = now() WHERE batch_id = $1 RETURNING batch_id

parameters.jsCode:
const s = $('Apply Decision').item.json;
return { json: { ...s, run_status: s.human.status === 'no_human_response' ? 'batch_no_response' : 'batch_rejected' } };

parameters.query: UPDATE revival_batches SET status = 'approved', decided_at = now() WHERE batch_id = $1 AND status = 'pending_approval' RETURNING batch_id

nodes.name: Approve Batch
nodes.notes: Solo aprueba si el lote seguía "pending_approval".

nodes.name: Expand Batch
nodes.notes: Un ítem por contacto del lote aprobado.

nodes.name: Dispatch Touch
nodes.notes: Llamada INTERNA a Send Touch, de a un lead cada 1.5 s. Reintento fijo (no el bucle exponencial: ese asume 1 ítem por ejecución). 202 = aceptado, 409 = bloqueado por la guarda, 200 = duplicado.

parameters.query: UPDATE revival_batches SET status = 'dispatched', summary = $2::jsonb WHERE batch_id = $1

nodes.name: Finish Run
nodes.notes: Todas las rutas terminan aquí: sin candidatos, lote rechazado, sin respuesta o despachado.

parameters.query: UPDATE idempotency_keys SET status = $2, finished_at = now(), result = $3::jsonb WHERE key = $1 AND execution_id = $4

nodes.name: Mark Idempotency
nodes.notes: Cierra la clave: done, o failed si algo falló (así un reintento sí puede reprocesar).

nodes.name: Assert Run
nodes.notes: Falla ruidosamente si algún despacho o el resumen fallaron → Error Handler.
